regime_context: The Canada/TSX detector shows a broad, eligible-trend field (62% of themes eligible) with a confirmed precious-metals leadership: Silver & Royalties leads Gold Miners by a narrow 0.145 margin, both with full breadth (1.0) and no crowding flag. The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market's history (gate_helps=true), so trend discipline did cut drawdown; however, the cross-sectional momentum rank itself is a focus lens with rank-IC ~0, and the trader's own track record shows direction accuracy of only 0.306, so all leans below are conditional and modest.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Gold Miners vs Silver & Royalties margin widens beyond ~0.3; if Gold Miners overtakes Silver & Royalties in rank score while both remain eligible and breadth stays at 1.0, that would retire the watch and point to a lasting precious-metals handoff worth a fresh checkable lean.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: The leader is trend-gate eligible (eligible=true) with full breadth (1.0), a strong relative score, and no crowding flag (crowded=false). This is a trend-following, vol-aware lean supported by the absolute-trend gate leg — the one validated edge — which keeps exposure to a durable theme while cutting drawdown risk. The narrow margin over Gold Miners (0.145) tempers conviction; both precious metals are advancing together, so this is a constructive hold-the-trend lean, not a momentum-return bet.
theses.dissent: With rank-IC ~0 on clean sectors, the top rank does not forecast returns; Silver & Royalties could be an attention peak, and the trader's direction accuracy of 0.306 argues for humility even on a leading trend.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO (proxy) closes below its own 50-day moving average for five consecutive trading days before the check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Eligible and ranked 3rd but flagged crowded=true (crowding_z=1.19). Per the guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — but a NEW lean on a crowded theme carries the documented failure mode of chasing attention. Given no return edge from momentum and the coincidence of crowding with a high rank, the disciplined choice is to avoid initiating a directional lean here until crowding clears.
evidence: guardrail: crowding/extension has no basket-level forward edge, only down-sizes
theses.dissent: Crowding is coincident, not predictive; the theme may continue to trend, and refusing to lean simply forfeits upside rather than reducing risk.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO (proxy) makes a new 20-day high while its crowding_z drops below 0.8 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
